content: {"like": ["Showstopper \"On My Own\" fits better in its new spot once the Act structure is abolished.", "Helena Bonham Carter is quite good enough to carry out Madame Thernardier the way it was meant when the song was written.", "Russell Crowe is a great actor and a good choice for Javert."], "dislike": ["The decision to film the music live, making the acting rather than the music be the force that carries the movie, results in voices that waver and sloppy singing.", "The overall decision to do the singing live is a poor choice that makes the acting rather than the music carry the movie.", "The song \"Master of the House\" is too slow, dreamlike, and does nothing to boost spirits after the horror.", "The rebel leader in \"One Day More\" standing with a rifle raised is a striking image that is lost when the rifle is missing.", "Hugh Jackman’s singing in a musical on TV was expected to be better, but was not.", "Russell Crowe’s singing is not up to scratch.", "The experiment with the movie is considered a stupid place to experiment, wasting money and potential.", "The reviewer prefers concert performances of the music over the film version."]}
